title: Desire
text: “Well, it might be better than going off and doing something unnecessary, nano.”

Quiet, brain-Rival! I did think about whether there was anything else to do, but nothing came to mind, that’s all, I say! Of course, as for Rival’s egg, all I need to do is chuck it into another world shortly before the wave hits, naturally!
“Remember this, nano……”

I keep telling you I won’t forget. There’s nothing for Rival to do this loop, I say! And so, while keeping half an eye on the village and Éclair’s parents from a distance, I indulged in some sketching time, indeed. Humming a little tune—hmm hmm hmmm—I drew away. Ah, I drew a nostalgic scene of Filo-tan back in the village. Come to think of it, since this was a rare glimpse of Big Sister’s village before the wave destroyed it, I decided to use that as the backdrop and pictured Filo-tan there. As a bonus, I drew her in a scene playing together with the sisters.
“Bu-bu-bu……”

In the distance, I could see Keel looking anxious, spending time in the village with the sisters, worried because her parent’s whereabouts were unknown. Quite the gloomy atmosphere. Don’t worry, I say. This loop, I’m keeping watch to make sure your parent survives, so you can relax and play more carelessly, I say. Honestly, Keel usually acts carefree even when the wave draws near, yet this loop she’s all anxious—quite out of character, I say.
“Well, obviously she’s anxious ’cause you kidnapped her parent, nano, can’t be helped.”

Brain-Rival, butting in and being noisy again. There’s no role for you here, I say. If anyone’s going to point that out, it ought to be Father. While drawing Filo-tan, I waited in my mind for Father’s retort, I say— and then, glancing at the picture I’d drawn, I thought, huh!?
“Hah!? Father!?”

There, I had somehow drawn Father, looking around with curious eyes at Big Sister’s village before its destruction. It had turned into an imagined scene where, having thwarted some conspiracy and been rescued, Father came to see the village at my invitation, I say! I’d meant to draw Filo-tan, yet I ended up drawing Father instead. Hmm…… it felt similar to that time we visited Panda’s village, yet with the sense of him surveying the surroundings while keeping some other loop in mind. Come to think of it, the layout of the village buildings was different in various ways. In that village, Father walked along happily, passing Big Sister as she dashed by, glancing back for just a moment before continuing on his way without incident, I say. That was the kind of composition I ended up drawing as well. Hmm…… this too seemed like a plausible scenario.
“That’s just your own wishful thinking, isn’t it?”

The picture turned out to be the sort that would get me scolded by Big Sister. Why would that be my own wish, I wonder? No, that’s not it, I say. I was drawing Filo-tan, I say! I continued drawing Filo-tan trotting along on a little walk through the village, I say. Filo-tan going to visit Big Sister’s house and greeting her parents there. A composition featuring people that Father and Filo-tan would never actually meet, I suppose.

Well, in any case, I did get to catch a glimpse of Big Sister’s parents, so I’ll count that as a win. What I could tell was that Big Sister’s future looks took after her father. Incidentally, Big Sister as a child had a rather plain, unremarkable look about her. It’s only once she grows up that she becomes the beauty known as Big Sister. In that respect, Big Sister’s friend and Keel actually left more of an impression, come to think of it.

If I add Father into the mix here—hmm, what circumstances would even lead to a situation where Father, Filo-tan, and the sisters are all together?... I couldn’t even tell if such a thing was possible. In that sort of way, I spent the time before the wave checking in with Four Heroes Church, doing my sketches, and otherwise staying active without sleep, catching naps here and there. Looking up at the church, I noticed one of the spear-shaped markers lit up, and word was spreading that somewhere, a Spear Hero had been summoned! Perhaps that merchant I recognized over in Zeltoble had sensed something because of this.
Well then…… the time until the wave had drawn considerably closer.

I had already secured the dragon egg and tossed it into another world. Rival’s banishment to another world was complete, I say! Now then. For the time being, the threats had taken effect, and Éclair’s parents and Big Sister’s village hadn’t gone out on any reckless fishing expeditions. Well, as a side effect of heightened alert, security had become quite tight. It turned out to be a convenient stroke of luck that the guard situation ended up this way, I say. And so, as arranged beforehand with Older Sister, I called her out to the designated spot and met up with her.
“The hostage is in this wooden crate, I say.”
“Oh my……”
I handed over the wooden crate containing the person who appeared to be Keel’s parent to Older Sister.
“The wave should hit in about thirty minutes, so be careful, I say. I’d like you to shake this one awake and head out to face it.”
“If that’s really true~”
Incidentally, Older Sister had come properly, taking care to avoid prying eyes. She still seemed half in disbelief, though. Her attitude seemed rather carefree.
“As discussed beforehand, Older Sister, I’m leaving the evacuation guidance and handling of the monsters to you, I say.”

If I were to be too active here myself, it would cause problems. I wanted to keep a low profile while minimizing the damage as much as possible. As for Older Sister’s skill, I had full confidence in it.

“Hmm…… since there was a bit of time before the wave, I wanted to strengthen Older Sister further, but letting her wander about too freely wasn’t really an option either, so it’s a bit late for that now, I say.”
“Oh my……”

A Class Up was impossible given how few allies we had to cooperate. Going to the information broker in Zeltoble—the assassins’ guild—might have gotten us a letter of introduction, but that would’ve been difficult. I did consider attempting to boost Older Sister’s latent abilities at the cost of her level, but her trust in me wasn’t enough, so the enhancement couldn’t be applied. She remained half in disbelief throughout. I felt I’d done everything I could, yet the thought crossed my mind that perhaps I could have acted more boldly. Truly, these had been troublesome days. Honestly, I’d rather have just rampaged my way through things more simply, but given past experience, patience was the order of the day here, I say. Watching the countdown to the wave float in my field of vision like the flow of time itself, I gave Older Sister a bow.
“My thanks for your cooperation, I say.”

The plan to hold back the overly strong sense of unity that insisted on going out fishing no matter what had worked out well. Managing to avoid giving Melromarc’s nobility any pretext to exploit was thanks to Older Sister’s cooperation, indeed.
“It’s fine, really~. It’s not like Older Sister believes you completely yet. There wasn’t much else to do, so Older Sister just did what she could.”

From what Older Sister said, it seemed she’d judged that she had no way of stopping me, and so had no choice but to go along with it. Her quick grasp of the strength situation was a huge help, indeed.
“Now then…… all that’s left is to disguise my appearance so the Three Heroes Church folk don’t catch on, I say.”
And so, I carefully cast a spell upon myself as well!
“By the power that is the wellspring of love, the Love Hunter commands. Unravel the laws of all creation once more, and alter the form of this one.”
“Four Fairy Morph! Pyon, I say!”

Poof! And just like that, I transformed into an usaunny form, pyon! Fuhahahaha! With this form, even if the Three Heroes Church happened to recognize the Spear Hero, they could hardly admit it, I say. Of course, I’d already prepared clothes to match, pyon!
“Oh my……”
Older Sister looked down at me, staring.
“Even smaller, my strength remains the same! The undefeated hunter, pyon!”

Hyun, hyun! I spun my spear around in warm-up exercises, I say. In my memory, Father said, ‘Who do you think you are, some kind of detective?...’ I’m no detective, but rather the Love Hunter and traveler through time, that’s me, right? Come to think of it, that reincarnated murderer Takt also went around calling himself some kind of great detective. Quite the joke, honestly. If anything, you’re more the full-body-black-tights type, pyon! I feel like Father once said something along those lines.
